spans.s: कोप m. 1. Passion, wrath, anger, अकैतव इवास्याः कोपो लक्ष्यते Sak.v., M.iii.230; 2. morbid irritation or disorder of the humours of the body (in medicine), as in पित्तकोप, वातकोप.
कोप-क्रम m. 1. an angry or passionate man; 2. the course of anger.
कोपन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Passionate, wrathful, irascible; 2. causing anger; 3. irritating, causing disorder of the humours of the body.
कोपन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Passionate, wrathful, irascible; 2. causing anger; 3. irritating, causing disorder of the humours of the body.
कोपना f. A passionate woman, सन्मार्गस्थे प्रणयिनि जने कोपने कोऽपराधः Am.
कोपिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Angry, सत्यमेवासि यदि सुदति मयि कोपिनी Git.G.x.; 2. causing anger; 3. causing disorder of the humours of the body.
कोपिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Angry, सत्यमेवासि यदि सुदति मयि कोपिनी Git.G.x.; 2. causing anger; 3. causing disorder of the humours of the body.
